scope: Manual research harness; no registered test or production source added by this evidence commit.

layout./study/hf: Pinned model files/cache, revision recorded in completed-qualification.json

step1.setup: Immutable image and package versions are recorded in completed-qualification.json. Build the source-overlay Rust radix extension using its repository torch_build_configuration helper; retain the default backend. Source hashes must match production-source-hashes.json.
step1.sequence: Run legacy then scoped in separate fresh containers, each with its own SCOPED_QUAL_OUTPUT and SGLANG_CACHE_DIR. Set SGLANG_ENABLE_FLASHINFER_GRAPH_AUTOTUNE=0 then 1. Execute registered_accuracy.py. Do not alter test arguments, prompts, accuracy floor or default scheduler/graph settings.
step1.analyze: python analyze_registered_accuracy.py --results RESULTS --source EXACT_SGLANG_SOURCE --dataset GSM8K_TEST_JSONL --output SUMMARY_JSON
step1.throughput: Observer timings and logged accuracy throughput are not performance evidence.

step2.setup: Export exact FlashInfer source 0bdafda8f721aaa4981c017a61b99f1122267edf into /study/flashinfer-main, generate the recorded local build metadata and isolate FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_BASE=/study/descriptor-workspace. Build the native sources from this tree; keep normal provider version checks enabled. Verified matching cutlass/cccl/spdlog dependencies from the 0.7.3 wheel can supply submodules.
step2.warm: In a fresh process/container with the same cache and source: python descriptor_probe.py --phase warm --cache /study/step2/probe-cache --output /study/step2/probe-warm.json --cold-result /study/step2/probe-cold.json
step2.scope: Explicit descriptor fixture uses real profiling and rank_tactics(k=2) only to exercise descriptor persistence; natural fixture retains ordinary default-inclusive selection.

raw_evidence: Full local evidence retains failed setup attempts, server logs, prompts/outputs, source, exact executed harnesses, caches, build logs, native binaries and hashes. Compact results are published here; no raw internal-cluster logs are published.
